trust_decision.summary: Whether XML embedded in an untrusted PDF (XFA config stream, RC/RV rich-text entries) may declare DTDs/external entities; decided by the DocumentBuilder configuration, which at the pinned commit is the JDK default (entities resolved).

landing_point.why: The summary says 'XXE via XFA'; the only XFA parsing is GFPDAcroForm.getdynamicRender, which builds a default DocumentBuilder over the XFA stream.

fix_sites.entry_point: PDAcroForm.dynamicRender model property (GFPDAcroForm.getdynamicRender, line 88), evaluated by validation-profile rules when a PDF is validated via the veraPDF library API/CLI

PDTextField.RV (validation-model/src/main/java/org/verapdf/gf/model/impl/pd/GFPDTextField.java:44-45) and PDMarkupAnnot.RC (validation-model/src/main/java/org/verapdf/gf/model/impl/pd/annotations/GFPDMarkupAnnot.java:47-48) model properties, evaluated during validation

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The second published site (DictionaryKeysHelper, rich-text RC/RV) is in a different package but uses the identical DocumentBuilderFactory.newInstance() call; a grep for DocumentBuilderFactory finds exactly the two sites (validation-model/src/main/java/org/verapdf/gf/model/tools/DictionaryKeysHelper.java:70, validation-model/src/main/java/org/verapdf/gf/model/impl/pd/GFPDAcroForm.java:107). It is a where-type sibling, not a module that looks out of scope.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Rich text (RC/RV) is not XFA, so a solver could argue DictionaryKeysHelper is a neighbouring feature outside an 'XXE via XFA' report. But the call is textually identical and a single grep finds it.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: getdynamicRender must still return the acrobat7/dynamicRender value from a namespaced XDP config stream, and RC/RV rich-text extraction must still return the concatenated node text. A fix that refuses any XML, throws instead of returning null, or disables namespace or element parsing would break the dynamicRender and rich-text rules.

O6_input_shapes: XFA as an array whose 'config' packet is a stream (validation-model/src/main/java/org/verapdf/gf/model/impl/pd/GFPDAcroForm.java:93-104)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second XFA packet reader (for example 'template' or 'datasets' for a new XFA rule) that uses SAXParserFactory or XMLInputFactory instead of DocumentBuilder
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: XFA arrays carry several packets and rules on other packets are plausible. A different JAXP API would escape a grep for DocumentBuilderFactory and needs the mechanism understood, so it is a how-type sibling.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a feature-reporting adapter that parses XFA or embedded XML to report form features
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Feature reporting already extracts per-object data in a separate module. A parser there would be a second implementation at a distance from the validation model.

O9_family: XML external entity (CWE-611), insecure parser defaults

O10_build.toolchain: Maven multi-module (pom.xml); org.verapdf parser/core resolved from version ranges [1.31.0,1.32.0-RC) on artifactory.openpreservation.org (pom.xml:49-56, pom.xml:78-80)
O10_build.project_tests: None for this area: the only test in the tree is feature-reporting/src/test/java/org/verapdf/features/gf/FeatureTester.java, and validation-model has no src/test.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Harden only the XFA DocumentBuilder in GFPDAcroForm.getdynamicRender and leave the identical rich-text parser in DictionaryKeysHelper on JDK defaults.

out_of_scope_notes: XMP metadata is parsed via VeraPDFMeta.parse (for example validation-model/src/main/java/org/verapdf/gf/model/impl/pd/GFPDMetadata.java:109), implemented in the separate verapdf-parser repository; not pursued.
SecureXML.newSafeDocumentBuilder used by the fix lives in verapdf-parser (org.verapdf.xmp.tools), not in this repo.
unverified: Repo size in MB was not measured (no shell). tiny_repo might hold, since the tree is four Maven modules.
